free_tier.stated: No free text allowance; Agent API models bill per token (e.g. anthropic/claude-haiku-5-5 at $0.10 input / $0.50 output per 1M for prompts at or under 100k) plus per-call tool fees.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an inference endpoint stores nothing for the caller

egress.terms: the response is the payload; no separate egress term is published

chaining: no free tier; tool fees accumulate on top of token cost

limits.value: per-token model rates plus per-call tool fees

identity_cost.detail: an account and shared API key from the console; no card gate stated on this page

reliability_note: service tiers flex (0.5x) and priority (2x) change token rates only for models that list them

evidence.proved: Agent API models are billed per token with published rates
evidence.quote: Pricing rates are published per model and may differ from provider list prices.
